messages:
Amanda L: Quick planning thread 1 webinar next Tue 10am PT. Need social plan: 2 X posts (pre + day-of), 1 X follow, 2 LinkedIn variations, and a 6-tweet X thread highlighting benchmark wins. Who owns copy + final asset polish?

Raj P: I can draft copy. CTA = webinar RSVP (cal.link). Target audience = PLG engineers + platform leads. Do we want a numbers-first A/B vs benefit-first?

Jen M: For visuals: can we reuse the benchmark chart from last month? I can crop/annotate but need confirmation on data license. Required exports: X hero 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x627, square 600x600, thread card 800x418.

Drew G: Ill make hero + GIF highlight. Timeline: need final copy by Friday EOD to build assets. GIF idea: animate the cost delta bar rising/falling. Good?

Amanda L: GIF yes. Timeline: copy -> Fri EOD, assets final -> Mon AM, schedule pre-post Tue 8:15am PT, day-of 9:50am PT, follow 12:30pm PT. Engagement cadence: replies at +10m, +1h, +4h from comms.

Raj P: Draft thread (very rough) below, open to edits. Short sentences for X.

1/ New webinar: real-world benchmark + playbooks to cut inference cost without trading quality. Register: [cal.link]
2/ We tested 5 open models under production traffic and measured latency + cost.
3/ Result: prefix caching + smart batching cut inference cost ~40% in our setup.
4/ Well demo rollout strategies to avoid warm-up latency during spikes.
5/ Live Q&A 1 bring infra & product questions.
6/ Sign up: [cal.link] #LLM #inference #redwood

Raj P: Tone okay? Too technical for LinkedIn maybe?

Jen M: For LinkedIn swap "token spend"/"inference cost" phrasing to "inference cost" and add a brief customer example: "A SaaS customer saw 2x throughput improvement in testing." Also add UTM params: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=webinar_may.

Amanda L: Routing: inbound signups -> Intercom inbox; mark MQL if company_size > 50 and attended or engaged. Standard tags: webinar_may, source:social, channel:x|linkedin. Sales notify for MQLs.

Drew G: Ill produce 1200x675, 1200x627, 600x600, and a GIF. Need the final hero line ASAP. Also confirm brand color for GIF accent (use #FF6A00?).

Raj P: Updated thread line 3 to: "prefix caching + smart batching cut inference cost ~40%" per Jen. Adding small CTA on line 6 with UTM.

Amanda L: SocialBot 1 when assets and copy are approved, schedule per template below and enable auto-replies for first 4 hours from comms lead.

SocialBot: @Amanda L  scheduling template received. To confirm run: `/schedule channel=marketing time=1755630720 assets=webinar_may_v1 copy=raj_v2 tags=webinar_may,source:social` React with :white_check_mark: to queue.

Jen M: Ill confirm chart license by Thu noon and add the LinkedIn-friendly sentence.

Drew G: :thumbsup: Mockups due Mon 09:00 PT.

Amanda L: Final copy deadline Fri 5pm PT. Raj, drop v2 here when ready so Jen/Drew can iterate.

Raj P: Will post v2 Fri ~3pm.

SocialBot: Reminder set for Amanda L and Drew G at 2025-05-16T17:00:00Z.
